title: Keep service tests at their owning behavior boundary
scope: Changes that add or materially expand tests under apps/api, apps/api-e2e, apps/services, or service E2E projects.
applies_when: A changed service test asserts behavior also represented by a consumed package, runtime, EDP, persistence, presenter, or vendor boundary.
violation: The test re-executes semantics not implemented by the service test's boundary and proves no service-owned composition, mapping, configuration, integration, or observable end-to-end behavior.
non_violation: A test that proves the consuming service's own wiring, mapping, route, configuration, or cross-boundary observable result is not duplicate merely because lower-level collaborators participate.
evidence: Cite the changed assertion, the lower boundary that owns the behavior, and why the test contains no service-owned behavior or integration evidence.
